eeg_primary: Primary electroencephalogram scalp lead; brain electrical activity during sleep.
eeg_secondary: Secondary electroencephalogram scalp lead; brain electrical activity during sleep.
eeg_tertiary: Tertiary electroencephalogram scalp lead; brain electrical activity during sleep.
eog_left: Left electrooculogram lead; electrical eye movement signal during sleep.
eog_right: Right electrooculogram lead; electrical eye movement signal during sleep.
emg: Electromyogram; electrical muscle activity during sleep.
leg: Leg electromyogram; electrical activity of leg muscles during sleep.
ecg: Electrocardiogram; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
pleth: Photoplethysmogram, also called pleth or PPG; optical blood volume pulse waveform.
airflow: Respiratory airflow waveform; air moving through the nose and mouth.
thoracic_effort: Thoracic respiratory effort waveform; chest movement during breathing.
abdominal_effort: Abdominal respiratory effort waveform; abdominal movement during breathing.
snore: Snore sensor waveform; acoustic or vibration signal produced by snoring.
spo2: Peripheral blood oxygen saturation time series measured by pulse oximetry.
heart_rate: Heart rate time series; beats per minute estimated from cardiac activity.
co2: Respiratory carbon dioxide concentration waveform measured at the airway.
airway_pressure: Airway pressure waveform measured by an anesthesia ventilator.
rr_primus: Respiratory rate time series derived from carbon dioxide by a Primus monitor.
rr_solar: Respiratory rate time series derived from carbon dioxide by a Solar8000 monitor.
bis_emg_power: Numeric electromyographic power in decibels reported by a BIS forehead monitor.
bis_eeg1: First frontal electroencephalogram waveform lead from a BIS anesthesia monitor.
bis_eeg2: Second frontal electroencephalogram waveform lead from a BIS anesthesia monitor.
ecg_ii: Electrocardiogram lead II; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_v5: Electrocardiogram lead V5; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
pulse_rate: Pulse rate time series estimated from a photoplethysmogram by a pulse oximeter.
ecg_i: Electrocardiogram lead I; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_iii: Electrocardiogram lead III; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_avr: Electrocardiogram lead aVR; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_avl: Electrocardiogram lead aVL; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_avf: Electrocardiogram lead aVF; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_v1: Electrocardiogram lead V1; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_v2: Electrocardiogram lead V2; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_v3: Electrocardiogram lead V3; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_v4: Electrocardiogram lead V4; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_v6: Electrocardiogram lead V6; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_d3: Electrocardiogram lead D3; electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_mli: Modified limb electrocardiogram lead I (MLI); electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_mlii: Modified limb electrocardiogram lead II (MLII); electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
ecg_mliii: Modified limb electrocardiogram lead III (MLIII); electrical activity of the heart measured at the skin.
eog_horizontal_bipolar: Horizontal bipolar electrooculogram; potential at the outer corner of the left eye minus potential at the outer corner of the right eye; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_vertical_bipolar: Vertical bipolar electrooculogram; potential above the right eye minus potential below the right eye; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e1: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E1 above the right eye, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e2: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E2 below the right eye, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e3: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E3 at the outer corner of the left eye, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e4: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E4 at the outer corner of the right eye, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e5: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E5 above the left eye, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e6: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E6 below the left eye, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e7: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E7 above and lateral to the left eye, 60 degrees above the horizontal outward direction, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e8: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E8 above and medial to the left eye, 60 degrees above the horizontal inward direction, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e9: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E9 above and medial to the right eye, 60 degrees above the horizontal inward direction, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e10: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E10 above and lateral to the right eye, 60 degrees above the horizontal outward direction, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e11: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E11 below and lateral to the left eye, 30 degrees below the horizontal outward direction, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e12: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E12 below and lateral to the right eye, 30 degrees below the horizontal outward direction, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e13: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E13 above and lateral to the left eye, 30 degrees above the horizontal outward direction, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e14: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E14 above and lateral to the right eye, 30 degrees above the horizontal outward direction, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e15: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E15 below and lateral to the left eye, 60 degrees below the horizontal outward direction, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
eog_monopolar_e16: Monopolar electrooculogram electrode E16 below and lateral to the right eye, 60 degrees below the horizontal outward direction, referenced to the left mastoid; electrical eye movement signal.
